_comment: Canonical test corpus for Framework's stress and benchmark suite.
Filenames are relative to the corpus root: $FW_TEST_CORPUS_ROOT if set,
otherwise the repo's gitignored .testfiles/ directory. These files are
copyrighted sample documents and are never committed; see tests/README.md
for how to populate .testfiles/ (or point FW_TEST_CORPUS_ROOT elsewhere).
Tags: large = >500 pages, scanned = image-heavy, djvu, comic,
